label: Code guards from the week's glitches (core/codeguards.py): named controls, typed web addresses, repo-root paths, steady ordering, no-flicker redraws

params.name: a11y_globs
params.label: Screen files whose buttons, links and fields must each have a name (aria-label, title, a label or their own words)

params.name: a11y_ceiling
params.label: Nameless controls allowed in those files (only falls)

params.name: host_exts
params.label: Code files read for typed web addresses

params.name: host_ok
params.label: Addresses that are never a real site (reserved test names, private / link-local / this-machine IPs, the SVG namespace) - not counted

params.name: host_ceiling
params.label: Real web addresses still typed in code instead of a chip (only falls - move one into a chip, then lower this)

params.name: cwd_path_re
params.label: A path read from wherever the script was started (Path("chips/...")) instead of from the repo root

params.name: order_tie_keys
params.label: Unique columns: an ORDER BY must end its terms with one, so equal values never swap places between two runs

params.name: push_globs
params.label: Screens that redraw on the push stream (onEvent) must write their HTML through paintIfChanged

params.name: say_a11y
params.default: {n} control(s) with no name a screen reader can say (ceiling {cap}) - add aria-label or title: {hits}
params.label: say a11y

params.name: say_hosts
params.default: {n} real web address(es) typed in code (ceiling {cap}) - read it from a chip (one place) instead: {hits}
params.label: say hosts

params.name: say_cwd
params.default: a path read from the folder the script was started in, not the repo root - build it from Path(__file__): {hits}
params.label: say cwd

params.name: say_order
params.default: an ORDER BY with no unique last term - equal values come back in another order run to run; add a tie-break (id): {hits}
params.label: say order

params.name: say_paint
params.default: a screen that redraws on the push stream writes innerHTML directly - every update flickers; use paintIfChanged(el, html): {hits}
params.label: say paint

description_nl: 2026-11-18 gap audit B3, week classes 18 / 40 / 41 / 42 / 47 (CodyFy G-40, G-45, G-84, G-53, G-23, G-83): a nameless icon-only button, a host or repo typed into a script that later moved, a fingerprint that read another folder, a list whose equal rows swapped places, an open screen that flickered on every pushed update. core/codeguards.py reads the code with these knobs (selfcheck part static); its own self-test plants each fault and must catch it. Ceilings only fall.
